name: The Deepest Well
pitch: Everything their ward pays runs down into your pool, and the moment your pool crosses your line you tip all of it back at them: wait for a fuller bucket against the wrong enemy and you die holding it.

new.name: Water Table
new.effect: Of the linh lực a target's ward pays for your hit, you gain 0.36, up to your maximum. Closes: your linh lực does not regenerate in a fight.
new.second_home: any leech or linh lực thief

new.name: Head of Water
new.effect: An art may pay everything above a keep line it names; its coefficient is the art lint's value for what it paid.

new.name: Long Rope
new.effect: +40 points to arts with the rope form.

new.name: Rich Seam
new.effect: +0.5 points to arts per 1 % the target's maximum linh lực exceeds yours, up to +60.

new.name: Bored Shaft
new.effect: Foreseen fights: +25 points to all hits and +0.10 to Water Table, from a shaft sunk at the place of the fight.
new.second_home: any fighter who picks the ground

new.name: Sweet Ward
new.effect: A curse may strengthen a ward: pass_raise -0.4, so it blocks more and pays for it.
new.second_home: a support who wards an ally

new.name: Scraping the Well
new.effect: When a drain ward's pool cannot pay what a hit asks, the unpaid linh lực lands on health, past body guard.

new.name: Salt
new.effect: Transmutation of Earth. Per purity: +0.20 ward_draw_pct, +0.15 ward_efficiency_pct, -0.10 tam_ma_resist_pct. 15 W at purity 50, 30 W at 100.

new.name: Deep Bore Sutra
new.effect: Main, Địa giai, Earth and Water. Carries Water Table, Scraping the Well, Head of Water, five arts, and seals Dry Courses.

new.name: Salted Well
new.effect: Curse, cost 0.09, 2 s, Rush Order: 3 pulses of drain raise +50 % and pass_raise -0.4.

new.name: The Whole Bucket
new.effect: Qi hit, pays all above its keep line, 2 s, guarded on own linh lực above your line. c_art is the lint value of what it paid.

new.name: Bored Shaft Array
new.effect: Foreseen only. Carries Bored Shaft. Ruins the ground for ten seasons.

new.name: Dry Courses
new.effect: Linh lực and wards, Earth, outer, sealed by a technique, size 9. Notables Thrift, Rich Seam, Longer Breath.

questions: Should a guard line be a number a player tunes, or a few set choices?
Should a curse ever be allowed to make a ward stronger?
A drain ward's resisted hit costs it more linh lực than an unresisted one, so strength can run a ward dry. Is that intended?
